sql: select market_ticker, side, limit_price, quantity, status, right(coalesce(cancel_reason,''),25) cr, created_at::text, (select string_agg(balance_cents::text || chr(64) || to_char(at,'HH24:MI'), chr(32)) from incentive_balance_observations where at > '2026-10-14 15:30') bal from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-10-14 15:40' or status in ('resting','partial','pending','submitted')) order by created_at desc limit 6
